records.source: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: Scales of deceit [are] an abomination of YHWH, but a full weight [is] his pleasure.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests dishonest scales, \q but an honest weight pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

L.1: Scales of deceit [are] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but a full weight [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

R.1: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates it when people cheat by using false scales. \q He is pleased when people weigh things honestly.

decisions.choice: scales ... weight: weighing goods for sale
decisions.reason: Goods and silver were weighed on balance scales against stone weights. A merchant could cheat with a false weight; the law forbade it (Leviticus 19:35–36; Deuteronomy 25:13–16; Proverbs 16:11; 20:10).

records.source: בָּֽא־זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת־צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה׃
records.gloss: Comes pride, and comes shame, but with [the] humble [is] wisdom.
pieces: When pride arrives, disgrace follows close behind, \q but the humble have wisdom.

L.2: Pride comes, and shame comes, \q but with [the] humble [is] wisdom.

R.2: Proud people end up being shamed. \q But humble people are wise.

decisions.choice: pride: presumption, arrogance
decisions.reason: The word (zadon) is arrogant self-will (13:10; 21:24).

decisions.choice: the humble: the modest
decisions.reason: The word (tsenuim) appears also in Micah 6:8, "walk humbly with your God".

records.source: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים יְשָׁדֵּֽם׃
records.gloss: [The] integrity of upright [people] guides them, but [the] crookedness of treacherous [people] destroys them.
pieces: The upright are guided by their integrity, \q but the treacherous are ruined by their own deceit.

L.3: [The] integrity of [the] upright guides them, \q but [the] crookedness of [the] treacherous destroys them.

R.3: Honesty guides good people. \q But dishonest people are destroyed by their lies.

decisions.choice: crookedness: twisting, deceit
decisions.reason: The word (selef) means to twist or overturn (13:6; 19:3).

records.source: לֹא־יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
records.gloss: Wealth does not profit in [the] day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
pieces: Riches are of no use on the day of wrath, \q but righteousness rescues from death.

L.4: Wealth does not profit in [the] day of wrath, \q but righteousness delivers from death.

R.4: When God judges, money will not help. \q But doing what is right can save your life.

decisions.choice: the day of wrath: the day of God's judgment
decisions.reason: A day when God acts in judgment (Zephaniah 1:18; Ezekiel 7:19). The second line repeats 10:2b.

records.source: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃
records.gloss: [The] righteousness of [the] blameless makes straight his way, but by his wickedness falls [the] wicked.
pieces: The righteousness of the blameless clears their road, \q but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

L.5: [The] righteousness of [the] blameless makes {{gender:their|his}} way straight, \q but by {{gender:their|his}} own wickedness [the] wicked falls.

R.5: Good people who do right have an easy road. \q Evil people fall because of the wrong they do.

decisions.choice: makes straight: as in 3:6
decisions.reason: In 3:6 the LORD makes the path straight; here the person's righteousness does, under him.

records.source: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃
records.gloss: [The] righteousness of upright [people] delivers them, but by [the] desire of treacherous [people] they are caught.
pieces: The righteousness of the upright sets them free, \q but the treacherous are trapped by their own greed.

L.6: [The] righteousness of [the] upright delivers them, \q but [the] treacherous are caught by [their own] craving.

R.6: Doing right saves good people. \q But dishonest people are trapped by their own greed.

decisions.choice: craving: greedy desire
decisions.reason: The word (hawwah) of 10:3. Their own desire is the trap (5:22).

records.source: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃
records.gloss: At [the] death of a wicked person, hope perishes, and [the] hope of strength perishes.
pieces: When the wicked die, their hope dies with them, \q and all they expected from their strength is gone.

L.7: When a wicked person dies, hope perishes, \q and [the] hope of strength is lost.

R.7: When evil people die, all their hopes die with them. \q Everything they counted on is gone.

decisions.choice: strength: wealth or power
decisions.reason: The word (onim) means strength or wealth (Hosea 12:8). With other vowels it reads "sorrows". Either way what the wicked relied on is lost.

records.source: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
records.gloss: A righteous [person] from trouble is rescued, and a wicked [person] comes in his place.
pieces: The righteous are rescued from trouble, \q and the wicked fall into it instead.

L.8: [The] righteous is rescued from trouble, \q and [the] wicked comes in {{gender:their|his}} place.

R.8: God saves good people from trouble. \q Then the trouble falls on evil people instead.

decisions.choice: comes in his place: the trap turns
decisions.reason: As Haman hanged on the gallows he built for Mordecai (Esther 7:10; compare 21:18).

decisions.choice: God saves
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who rescues; the Hebrew passive leaves him unnamed.

records.source: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃
records.gloss: By [the] mouth a godless [person] ruins his neighbor, but by knowledge [the] righteous are delivered.
pieces: With their words the godless bring ruin on their neighbors, \q but the righteous escape by knowing better.

L.9: With [{{gender:their|his}}] mouth [the] godless destroys {{gender:their|his}} neighbor, \q but by knowledge [the] righteous are rescued.

R.9: Evil people hurt others with their words. \q But good people are saved because they know what is true.

decisions.choice: godless: a hypocrite, one who cares nothing for God
decisions.reason: The word (haneph) is someone who is defiled and godless, often hiding it (Job 8:13; Isaiah 33:14).

records.source: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃
records.gloss: When [the] righteous prosper, a town rejoices, and when wicked [people] perish, [there is] a shout of joy.
pieces: When the righteous do well, the whole town celebrates; \q when the wicked perish, there are cheers.

L.10: When [the] righteous prosper, [the] town rejoices, \q and when [the] wicked perish, [there is] a shout of joy.

R.10: When good people do well, the whole town is happy. \q When evil people die, everyone shouts for joy.

decisions.choice: a town: the community as a whole
decisions.reason: Verses 10–11 speak of the city: the righteous are good for everyone.

records.source: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃
records.gloss: By [the] blessing of upright [people] a town is exalted, but by [the] mouth of wicked [people] it is torn down.
pieces: A city is built up by the blessing of the upright, \q but the talk of the wicked tears it down.

L.11: By [the] blessing of [the] upright a town is raised up, \q but by [the] mouth of [the] wicked it is torn down.

R.11: Good people help a town grow strong. \q But the words of evil people can destroy it.

decisions.choice: blessing: the good the upright bring, and their prayers for it
decisions.reason: The blessing may be the good they do or the blessing they speak (Jeremiah 29:7).

records.source: בָּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃
records.gloss: [One] despising his neighbor [is] lacking heart, but a person of understanding keeps silent.
pieces: Whoever belittles a neighbor has no sense, \q but a person of understanding holds their tongue.

L.12: One who despises {{gender:their|his}} neighbor lacks heart, \q but a person of understanding keeps quiet.

R.12: It is foolish to make fun of your neighbors. \q A person who understands keeps quiet.

decisions.choice: despises ... keeps quiet: contempt spoken aloud
decisions.reason: The first line is about saying what one thinks of a neighbor; the wise keep it to themselves.

records.source: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃
records.gloss: [One] going about [as] a slanderer reveals a secret, but [one] faithful of spirit conceals a matter.
pieces: A gossip goes around giving away secrets, \q but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.

L.13: One who goes about [as] a slanderer reveals a secret, \q but one faithful in spirit keeps a matter covered.

R.13: Gossips tell other people's secrets. \q A person you can trust keeps quiet.

decisions.choice: slanderer: a gossip, a talebearer
decisions.reason: The word (rakil) is one who goes about carrying stories (20:19; Leviticus 19:16).

records.source: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
records.gloss: When there is no guidance, a people falls, but victory [is] in a multitude of counselors.
pieces: Without wise direction a nation falls, \q but with many advisers comes victory.

L.14: Where [there is] no guidance a people falls, \q but victory [is] in [the] many counselors.

R.14: A nation will fall without good leaders. \q But with many people giving good advice, it will be safe.

decisions.choice: guidance: skill in steering (1:5)
decisions.reason: The steering word of 1:5. A nation needs it as a ship needs a helmsman.

decisions.choice: victory: deliverance, safety
decisions.reason: The word (teshuah) is rescue or victory, often in war (21:31; 24:6).

records.source: רַע־יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃
records.gloss: Harm he will suffer when he stands surety [for] a stranger, but [one] hating striking hands [is] secure.
pieces: Whoever guarantees a stranger's debt will be badly hurt, \q but whoever refuses to shake on such deals is safe.

L.15: {{gender:They|He}} will surely suffer harm who stands surety [for] a stranger, \q but one who hates striking hands [is] secure.

R.15: If you promise to pay a stranger's debt, you will get hurt. \q If you refuse to make such promises, you will be safe.

decisions.choice: stands surety ... striking hands: as in 6:1–5
decisions.reason: The warning of 6:1–5, in one line.

records.source: אֵֽשֶׁת־חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹֽשֶׁר׃
records.gloss: A woman of grace takes hold of honor, and ruthless [men] take hold of wealth.
pieces: A gracious woman gains honor, \q and ruthless men gain only riches.

L.16: A gracious woman takes hold of honor, \q and ruthless [men] take hold of wealth.

R.16: A kind woman is respected. \q Cruel men may get rich, but that is all they get.

decisions.choice: a gracious woman ... ruthless men: honor against mere wealth
alternatives: two ways of getting what one wants
decisions.reason: The lines may contrast honor won by grace with wealth seized by force, or simply set them side by side. The ancient Greek translation has two extra lines here.

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "only" to bring out the contrast (m1).

records.source: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי׃
records.gloss: A person of loyalty deals well with his self, but a cruel [person] troubles his flesh.
pieces: People who are kind do themselves good, \q but the cruel bring harm on their own bodies.

L.17: A person of loyal love does good to {{gender:their|his}} own self, \q but [the] cruel brings trouble on {{gender:their|his}} own flesh.

R.17: When you are kind to others, you help yourself. \q When you are cruel, you hurt yourself.

decisions.choice: loyal love: kindness (hesed)
decisions.reason: The word of 3:3. Kindness returns to the kind.

records.source: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃
records.gloss: A wicked [person] earns a wage of falsehood, but [one] sowing righteousness, a reward of truth.
pieces: The wicked earn pay that does not last, \q but whoever sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

L.18: [The] wicked earns deceptive wages, \q but one who sows righteousness [gets] a true reward.

R.18: The money evil people earn will not last. \q But people who do what is right will get a reward that lasts.

decisions.choice: deceptive ... true: wages that fail and a reward that holds
decisions.reason: Wordplay: "falsehood" (sheqer) and "reward" (seker) sound alike. False wages disappoint; true ones are dependable.

records.source: כֵּן־צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: True righteousness [leads] to life, but [one] pursuing evil [leads] to his death.
pieces: Real righteousness leads to life, \q but chasing after evil leads to death.

L.19: Genuine righteousness [leads] to life, \q but one who pursues evil [goes] to {{gender:their|his}} death.

R.19: Doing what is right leads to life. \q Chasing after evil leads to death.

decisions.choice: genuine: firm, true
decisions.reason: The word (ken) can mean "so" or "firm, true". The ancient Greek reads "a righteous son".

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
records.gloss: An abomination of YHWH [are] the crooked of heart, but his pleasure [are the] blameless of way.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests those with twisted hearts, \q but people of integrity are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

L.20: [The] crooked of heart [are] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but [the] blameless in [their] way [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

R.20: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates it when people are dishonest in their hearts. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is happy with people who live honestly.

decisions.choice: abomination ... delight: as in verse 1
decisions.reason: The same pair as verse 1, now of people rather than weights.

records.source: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃
records.gloss: Hand to hand, an evil [person] will not go unpunished, but [the] offspring of righteous [people] will escape.
pieces: Be sure of this: the wicked will not escape punishment, \q but the children of the righteous will go free.

L.21: Hand to hand, [the] evil will not go unpunished, \q but [the] offspring of [the] righteous will escape.

R.21: You can be sure that evil people will be punished. \q But the children of good people will be safe.

decisions.choice: hand to hand: you may be sure
decisions.reason: The phrase is a pledge, like shaking hands on it: certainly (16:5).

records.source: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃
records.gloss: A ring of gold in [the] nose of a pig, a beautiful woman turning aside [from] discernment.
pieces: A lovely woman who has no sense \q is a gold ring stuck in a pig's snout.

L.22: A gold ring in a pig's snout: \q a beautiful woman who has turned from good sense.

R.22: A beautiful woman who does foolish things \q is like a pig wearing a gold ring in its nose.

decisions.choice: a gold ring in a pig's snout: beauty wasted
decisions.reason: Women wore nose rings as jewelry (Genesis 24:47). Put on a pig, an unclean animal rooting in the mud, the gold is wasted.

decisions.choice: good sense: discretion, taste
decisions.reason: The word (taam) is taste, and so judgment (26:16).

records.source: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃
records.gloss: [The] desire of righteous [people] [is] only good; [the] hope of wicked [people] [is] wrath.
pieces: What the righteous long for ends only in good, \q but what the wicked hope for ends in wrath.

L.23: [The] desire of [the] righteous [ends] only in good; \q [the] hope of [the] wicked [in] wrath.

R.23: Good people want what is good, and they get it. \q Evil people hope for bad things, and they get punished.

decisions.choice: good ... wrath: the outcome of each
decisions.reason: The line says where each desire ends, as in 10:28.

records.source: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
records.gloss: There is [one] scattering and he is increased still, and [one] holding back from what is right, only to want.
pieces: One person gives freely and gains even more; \q another holds back what should be given and ends up in need.

L.24: There is one who scatters, yet gains still more, \q and one who holds back more than is right, \q yet [comes] only to want.

R.24: Some people give a lot away and get even richer. \q Other people hold on to what they should give, and they end up poor.

decisions.choice: scatters: gives freely
decisions.reason: The verb (pizzer) means to scatter seed, and so to give generously (Psalm 112:9; 2 Corinthians 9:9).

records.source: נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא׃
records.gloss: A person of blessing will be made fat, and [one] giving water, also he will be watered.
pieces: A generous person will prosper, \q and whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

L.25: A generous person will be made fat, \q and one who waters, {{gender:they|he}} also will be watered.

R.25: If you are generous, you will have plenty. \q If you help others, you will be helped.

decisions.choice: a person of blessing: a generous person
decisions.reason: "Blessing" here is a gift (Genesis 33:11). "Made fat" means well fed, prosperous.

decisions.choice: will be watered: the form is unusual
decisions.reason: The verb form is rare; the sense is clear from the parallel.

records.source: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
records.gloss: [One] holding back grain, a people curses him, but a blessing [is] on [the] head of [one] selling [it].
pieces: People curse the one who hoards grain, \q but they bless the one who sells it.

L.26: [The] people curse one who holds back grain, \q but a blessing [is] on [the] head of one who sells [it].

R.26: People curse those who keep grain to sell at a higher price. \q But they bless those who sell it when people need it.

decisions.choice: holding back grain: hoarding in hard times
decisions.reason: A merchant could store grain in a shortage to drive the price up (Amos 8:4–6). Selling it when people need it is a blessing (Genesis 42:6).

records.source: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
records.gloss: [One] seeking good earnestly seeks favor, but [one] seeking evil, it will come to him.
pieces: Whoever works hard for what is good finds favor, \q but trouble comes to anyone who looks for it.

L.27: One who eagerly seeks good seeks favor, \q but one who searches for evil, it will come to {{gender:them|him}}.

R.27: If you try hard to do good, people will like you. \q If you look for trouble, you will find it.

decisions.choice: favor: goodwill, from God and people
decisions.reason: The word (ratson) of 8:35.

records.source: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃
records.gloss: [One] trusting in his wealth, he will fall, but like foliage righteous [people] will flourish.
pieces: Those who put their trust in riches will fall, \q but the righteous will flourish like green leaves.

L.28: One who trusts in {{gender:their|his}} wealth, {{gender:they|he}} will fall, \q but [the] righteous will flourish like foliage.

R.28: People who trust in their money will fall. \q But good people will grow strong like a healthy plant.

decisions.choice: like foliage: like a tree by water
decisions.reason: The picture of Psalm 1:3 and Jeremiah 17:8: a tree whose leaf does not wither.

records.source: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל־ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם־לֵֽב׃
records.gloss: [One] troubling his household will inherit wind, and a fool [will be] a slave to [the] wise of heart.
pieces: Whoever brings trouble on their family will inherit nothing but wind, \q and the fool will end up serving the wise.

L.29: One who brings trouble on {{gender:their|his}} household will inherit wind, \q and [the] fool [will be] slave to [the] wise of heart.

R.29: If you cause trouble for your family, you will end up with nothing. \q A fool will end up working for a wise person.

decisions.choice: inherit wind: end up with nothing
decisions.reason: Wind is what cannot be held (Ecclesiastes 1:14; Hosea 8:7).

decisions.choice: slave: a servant to pay debts
decisions.reason: A ruined man could be sold to pay his debts (Exodus 21:2).

records.source: פְּֽרִי־צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹתחָכָֽם׃
records.gloss: [The] fruit of [the] righteous [is] a tree of life, and [one] taking lives [is] wise.
pieces: What the righteous produce is a tree of life, \q and whoever wins people over is wise.

L.30: [The] fruit of [the] righteous [is] a tree of life, \q and one who takes lives [is] wise.

R.30: The things good people do are like a tree that gives life. \q A wise person wins others over to doing right.

decisions.choice: takes lives: wins people over
alternatives: takes away lives (with a small correction: violence takes away lives)
decisions.reason: "Taking lives" usually means killing (1:19), but here, beside the tree of life, it means winning people and drawing them to life. The ancient Greek reads "the lives of the lawless are taken away".

decisions.choice: a tree of life: as in 3:18

records.source: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
records.gloss: Look, a righteous [person] on earth is repaid; how much more [the] wicked and [the] sinner!
pieces: If even the righteous are paid what they are due on earth, \q how much more will the wicked and sinners be!

L.31: Look, [the] righteous is repaid on earth; \q how much more [the] wicked and [the] sinner!

R.31: If good people get what they deserve here on earth, \q evil people and sinners will certainly get what they deserve.

decisions.choice: how much more: an argument from lesser to greater
decisions.reason: If the righteous are disciplined in this life, the wicked will surely be judged. 1 Peter 4:18 quotes the ancient Greek form: "If the righteous is scarcely saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"

decisions.choice: repaid: given what is due, good or bad
decisions.reason: The verb (shillem) means to pay back in full; for the righteous it may be discipline (3:12).
